files.comments: Cracked Joystick Club release. This is the "Kraits" version.
Cracked to bypass the Lenslock protection if failed three times
Bugfixes by Ast A. Moore: This version loads on a +2A/+3 in 128K mode and the sampled speech is not distorted.  It still works on other Spectrum models.

files.comments: Modified version supports both English and Spanish, an alternate key-layout and faster circle drawing at the end
